answer: Require every new agent to register through a burn registry before trading. First, it creates one keypair and sends 50 tokens to a burn address nobody can spend from. Second, the registry logs the burn and waits 7 days, checking no other keypair claims the same burn. Third, it issues one non-transferable trading credential, revoked if duplicates appear. Forging 10,000 fake identities burns 500,000 tokens, about $200,000 at $0.40 each, plus 70,000 days of staggered waiting. Like a grove where each timber cabin sits on its own knoll, one plot cannot pose as a village.
